report_identity.report_title: Singamas Container Holdings Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: Singamas manufactures dry freight, tank, specialised and customised containers, develops container leasing, and provides container logistics services in China and internationally.

segments.business_substance: Container manufacturing and dry-container leasing revenue.
Container storage, handling, repair, drayage, freight station and related services.

business_overview.revenue_model: Container sales are recognised when control transfers after inspection/acceptance and delivery when applicable; some customers make upfront payments and remaining balances settle within credit terms. Leasing revenue comes from finance lease interest income and operating lease income.
business_notes: Dry freight containers represented 55% of manufacturing segment revenue; ISO-specialised and customised containers represented 45%.
The group is expanding customised and energy-storage-system container capacity and container leasing.
